text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and analyse text in a useful way. For example, NLP helps computers with text understanding, so they can find the main ideas in a document. It also makes translation possible, so we can quickly change text from one language into another. Another common use is sentiment analysis, which shows whether a review is positive or negative. Finally, NLP powers chatbots, which can answer our questions online. Thanks to NLP, technology communicates with us more naturally every day.
